item: Field-wide pattern (June 2026): every agent-memory product gates quality at WRITE time with an LLM judge, and handles decay REACTIVELY — a fact only goes stale when a contradicting fact arrives (bi-temporal valid_at/invalid_at + created_at/expired_at). Even Zep/Graphiti, the gold standard, has NO proactive staleness sweep (confirmed in paper + issues): a stale-but-uncontradicted fact lives forever.

Decay camp 1 (reactive / bi-temporal): Zep/Graphiti, Mem0-g (soft-invalidate), Cognee (versioning), zonoid. New contradicting fact closes the old fact's validity window; old fact retained, never deleted. Precise/auditable/supports as-of queries. Limitation: only fires on contradiction.

Decay camp 2 (proactive / forgetting-curve): FadeMem (dual Weibull curves), YourMemory (Ebbinghaus + recall boost), MemoryBank, MemoryOS (heat score), SSGM (theoretical). Score decays with time/disuse, prune below threshold, recall reinforces. Bounds graph growth but BLIND TO TRUTH — prunes valid-but-rarely-accessed facts; MemoryBank performs worst in its own benchmark. Almost nobody combines camp 1 + camp 2.

Other decay handling: Letta/MemGPT + MemOS = eviction/lifecycle (FIFO + recursive summarization; state machine Generated→…→Expired) with no importance weighting (drops oldest regardless of value). Mem0/Glean = re-rank only (recent access 1.5x, unused 0.3x; nothing deleted → stale facts resurface). A-MEM/Memary/LangMem/all GraphRAG-family = NO decay (timestamps stored but never used to prune; logically-stale edges persist forever).

Quality-gate dominant pattern = Mem0 AUDN: per fact, an LLM picks ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NOOP against top-k similar memories. Core flaw shared by Mem0/FadeMem/Zep: the SAME model extracts AND judges → correlated failure (the judge inherits the extractor's hallucination).

Quality-gate variants: Zep bi-temporal contradiction check (no confidence floor — any non-duplicate fact enters); FadeMem 4-way conflict classes (Compatible/Contradictory/Subsumptive/Subsumed); DEG-RAG LLM judge on 5 criteria dropping triples <0.2 (dropped ~40% of triples, lifted LightRAG win-rate 42%→58%); RGMem corroboration threshold θ_inf=3 (don't update memory until ≥3 episodes corroborate); SSGM NLI verify-before-write; traceable-validation RAG-over-Wikipedia (88% precision but only 44% recall).

PRODUCTION VALIDATION that unjudged automatic memory accretion fails: Cursor REMOVED its Memories feature in 2.1.x and told users to convert to manually-authored Rules. ChatGPT memory was 41.5% factually accurate in 2024, fixed only by adding a background-synthesis pass ('Dreaming') → 82.8% — i.e. they had to bolt on a judging/consolidation loop after the fact. Both confirm the recorded thesis: the judging loop, not the memory, is the moat.

Borrowable gaps for zonoid (priority order): (1) DECAY ON USEFULNESS not age — biggest unrealized edge; feed the recall-outcome journal into a graded decay/confidence score (reinforce notes that pay off, decay never-recalled-and-helpful), bridging the reactive + forgetting-curve camps without the latter's 'kills valid-but-quiet facts' downside; natural home = stale_flags in the KB-learner run record; THIS IS task #1 (note-decay). (2) corroboration threshold (RGMem θ_inf) before a curious_candidate becomes inject-eligible. (3) scalar confidence floor (DEG-RAG) for a graded inject gate vs the current ~binary judge. (4) subsumption not just supersession (FadeMem): handle 'new note more specific/general than existing' → merge/refine. DO NOT copy: time-based TTL / decay-by-deletion — keep the bi-temporal close-window-never-delete approach (strictly safer for auditability + as-of).

title: Competitive position vs agent memory products: outcome-grounded judging is the unique edge; decay-on-usefulness is the top gap
summary: Cross-competitor synthesis (extends survey note-mqgqarwuqkz) on knowledge decay + low-quality-write handling across agent-memory products. HEADLINE: the whole field gates quality at WRITE time with an LLM judge and handles decay only REACTIVELY — a fact goes stale only when a contradicting fact arrives; even Zep/Graphiti (gold standard) has NO proactive staleness sweep. zonoid is at PARITY with Zep on the bi-temporal/structural axis (validFrom/validTo + supersedes chains + as-of retrieval) and genuinely AHEAD on quality — the only design that ALSO judges on downstream OUTCOME, not just at ingestion. Three things no competitor combines: (1) a SEPARATE adversarial judge (not the extractor judging itself → defeats the correlated-failure flaw in Mem0/FadeMem/Zep where one model both writes and gates); (2) OUTCOME-grounded quality via the recall-outcome attribution seam (did the note actually make a downstream task cheaper/succeed — post-hoc ground truth the write-time judges structurally cannot access); (3) the empirical/non-derivable content bar (structurally excludes the derivable noise that clogged Cursor/ChatGPT memories). PRODUCTION VALIDATION of the 'judging loop is the moat' thesis: Cursor REMOVED its Memories feature in 2.1.x (→ manual Rules); ChatGPT memory was 41.5% factually accurate in 2024, fixed only by bolting on a background-synthesis 'Dreaming' pass → 82.8%. TOP UNREALIZED EDGE: decay on USEFULNESS not age — feed recall-outcome into a graded decay/confidence score (reinforce on payoff, decay on never-recalled-and-helpful), bridging the reactive and forgetting-curve camps without the latter's 'kills valid-but-quiet facts' downside; this is exactly task #1 (note-decay). ONE-LINE POSITION: everyone gates at the door with the same LLM that wrote it and forgets only when contradicted; zonoid gates with an independent judge, keeps only empirically-discovered knowledge, and re-grades notes by whether they paid off downstream — Cursor's and ChatGPT's memory fai
